scope: Offline filesystem ELF content only; kernel images, resources, configs and boot sections are separate units. No target execution.

semantic_completion.reason: No established total semantic work-unit/function denominator; static findings do not demonstrate device behavior.

definitions.source_verified: Inventory source-inode bytes match extraction; same debugfs implementation, not an independent parser.
definitions.imported_with_success_receipt: Validated schema-v2 export, same-run successful -import receipt and inventory-matched input manifest.
definitions.loaded_program_export_validated: Validated schema-v2 artifact hashes/counts and matching successful run receipt; includes restored -process -noanalysis.
definitions.auto_analysis_completed_with_success_rec: Validated export generated during same-run enabled auto-analysis, success receipt and explicit no-timeout flag. Conservative matched-generation evidence, not a count of every historical analysis; process/noanalysis exports can preserve previously analyzed programs.
definitions.selected_decompilation_completed: At least one completed selected function; not whole-program decompilation or understanding.
definitions.reviewed_static_findings: At least one accepted explicit reviewed unit names this SHA as its primary source. Additional-source anchors stay attached to the finding; they do not silently create more reviewed units or primary-source counts.
definitions.function_counts: Deduplicated by source SHA256 + original ELF VA; exported mapped nonexternal function records only, not all firmware functions.
definitions.subsystem_label_hints: Overlapping filename substrings from coverage.py; navigation hints, never semantic subsystem assignments.
definitions.ranking: Deterministic heuristic navigation queue; not a measure of user value, risk or semantic completion.

reviewed_units.method: Original ELF Thumb call/argument and literal inspection follows argv[1] into output path cell, /etc/fstab reader, mount writer and fopen64 wxe mode.
reviewed_units.limitations: This generator writes unit files in its supplied directory. Exclusive create does not independently test /etc/systemd/system and does not prove a live mount. Direct static disassembly, not target execution.
unresolved_questions: Which generator invocation and output directory are used during actual boot?
How do initrd and resume paths change the live mount transaction?
